text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accusary.
- Macedonian-Yugoslav expert groups are discussing demarcation of their joint border.
- Macedonia has offered its Krivolak military test range as a NATO training centre, said Macedonian Defence Minister Lazar Kitanovski.
- The Macedonian government has decided to build a military port near the village of Radozda, lake Ohrid, at the Macedonian-Albanian border. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +381 11 222 4305
